minors.issue: url.URL.Query() silently drops query pairs that fail to parse (bad percent-escape, semicolon), so they are neither checked against the inputs nor refused; decodeBody has the same gap for POST/PUT.
minors.scenario: GET /v1/servers?bogus=%zz is answered 200 instead of 400 unknown query parameter; GET ...?domain=%zz treats domain as absent instead of failing.

minors.issue: The GET kind check accepts any slice whose element kind is string, but decodeQuery assigns a []string with reflect.Value.Set, which panics when the element is a named string type, so mount accepts an In it cannot serve.
minors.scenario: A GET In with `Domains []DomainName` (type DomainName string) mounts without error, and every request sending ?domains=x panics in v.Field(i).Set instead of failing at startup.
